journey: create completed Backtest -> stop owned API child process -> start new owned API child process on same port -> reload UI -> open history -> open result
process_safety: The Playwright test stops only the ChildProcess object it started; it does not enumerate or kill unrelated PIDs.
storage_boundary: The default API service uses E:/strategy_test_data/autotrade/backtest/results and E:/strategy_test_data/autotrade/backtest/catalog.
assertions: The Run is SUCCEEDED before the API restart.
The same Run ID is present after the API restart.
The post-restart metrics equal the pre-restart metrics.
The post-restart provenance equals the pre-restart provenance.
The post-restart rows equal the pre-restart rows.
The UI history row and result-open action are available after reload.
The UI shows the five metrics and Ledger after restoration.
